tei:div.tei:p: phyag 'tshal bsdus pa ni/ e ma ho: chos rnams rnam dag ye nas lhun grub cing : bya ba byed dang yid chos rnam par dag: chos dbyings ye shes mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i: kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo: chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang : gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal: thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i: rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo: ngo mtshar pho brang bde bar gshegs pa'i yum: dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed mdzad cing : bde stong zung 'jug yab kyi sku la 'khril: rigs kyi yum mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: rnam shes phung po dag pa'i sku gsung thugs: bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras mchog ste: nyon mongs spyod pa'i skyon dang bral ba yi: sems dpa' chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar bcas: bdug spos me tog mar me dri chab ma: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchod pas mnyes mdzad pa'i: mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa: bdud bzhi'i dpung dang bgegs tshogs rnam par 'joms: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi thub par bsrung : ta krita sgo ba bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: rtag chad mthar bzhi gsang ba yum gyi ngang : mi mthun phyogs 'joms rab 'jigs khro mo'i tshul: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma: ye shes sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten 'dul ba'i gtso: nyon mongs drug 'joms rgyu drug dag par sbyongs: 'gro drug 'dren mdzad sprul pa'i skur ston pa: bcom ldan thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal lo: chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang : gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs skur ston cing : gdug pa 'dul phyir khro chen 'bar ba'i sku: dpal chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: khro rgyal dbang phyug sku la 'khril mdzad cing : dgyes pa bskyed phyir dung khrag yab la stob:

khro mo mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ma: kro ti shwa ri yum la phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje thabs mkhas ma rung 'dul mdzad cing : ye shes mtshon chas nyon mongs ma lus gcod: srid gsum bla med dbyings su 'dren mdzad pa: rigs bzhi khrag 'thung tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: khrag 'thung so so'i yab kyi sku la 'khril: khro mo'i gzugs kyis log lta zil gyis gnon: 'gro rnams thugs rjes 'dren phyir mdzad pa'i yum: rigs bzhi khro mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: sgeg mo la sogs 'bar ba'i nyams ldan zhing : ye shes sku mchog 'jigs byed rgyan gyis brgyan: kau'u rī khro mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing : 'dod dgu bsgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che: ma sring byams pa'i tshul gyis grogs mdzad ma: sengha phra men brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi: 'gugs dang 'ching bsdoms myos pa'i las kun mdzad: shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi thub par bsrung : sgo srung khro mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo: dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badz+ra a ra li: mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro ma tshogs dbang phyug ma: srin mo'i cha lugs 'jigs pa'i mgo brnyan can: rnal 'byor nyi shu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: ces phyag 'tshal lo/
